title: OUTER / INNER / LOWER — Cairns at Every Data Source
convention: 0=false 1=true 000=ALL null=ALL. Cairns ARE totems. NOT totalities.

cairn_purpose.what: A cairn marks WHERE data lives so we can return and see it in tense
cairn_purpose.why: Stale counts are dead. Cairns are LIVING markers — they say COME BACK HERE
cairn_purpose.shape: Each cairn has: source, tense, depth, last_touched, inherit_from
